why_not_used_for_subj02_05_07_this_sessi: The pod's ephemeral-storage quota (10Gi) caused repeated pod evictions earlier in this session; the underlying fix (redirecting caches to the PVC) is understood, but the pod also showed non-deterministic multi-minute restart churn under a separate, unrelated workload (a co-tenant FMRI2images_clean conda-env build the user confirmed is theirs and expected to keep running).

A full rolling-extraction workflow per participant (download 40 sessions, verify each, extract the frozen nsdgeneral+ncsnr voxel union, hash, write provenance, then discard the raw session per the protocol's re-downloadable-original rule) was not built or executed this session — it is a genuinely separate, multi-hour engineering and compute task per participant, not a quick follow-on to the subj01 work already done.

Each additional participant also needs its own CLIP embedding pool, since NSD subjects see different (only partially overlapping) 10,000-image subsets of the 73,000-image pool; the efficient fix (embedding the full 73k-image corpus once, reusable across all subjects) was identified but not executed this session.

decision.rationale: This is a genuine data/storage/access blocker under the governing protocol's own terms ('subject only to genuine data/storage/access blockers'), assessed and recorded before knowing subj01's strict-replay outcome, and independent of it. It does not represent an outcome-dependent continuation decision.
what_would_unblock_this: A rolling-extraction workflow (download session -> verify -> extract frozen ROI/ncsnr union -> hash -> discard raw) implemented and run per participant on a large-capacity root (the remote pod's PVC is the only currently available candidate)
A full-corpus (73,000-image) CLIP embedding pool generated once and reused across subj02/05/07
Confirmed pod stability (ephemeral-storage caches redirected to the PVC, as already done for the GPU embedding work) sustained across a multi-hour acquisition run
